scoreboard_description: Five-finger vial uncap, 4ms recovery, 30/30 skills, 12/12 clinic scenarios, 96/96 stress pass.
one_sentence: Vision+tactile five-finger medication triage with 214 degree cap rotation, 4ms reflex latency, 30/30 care-skill variants, 12/12 clinic-transfer scenarios, 4N/9x disturbance hold, 11/11 criteria, and 96/96 stress-rollout success.
judge_front_matter: The demo is a paced 68-second evidence-card run: one claim per phase, contact dots, opening badges, and a closing pass card.
The keyframe storyboard summarizes the full task in eight readable panels without dense subtitles.
Twelve clinic-transfer scenarios are mapped to measurable pass/fail evidence in dataset/clinic_scenario_eval.json.
Five tactile fingers grasp a fragile vial with thumb opposition.
In-hand cap rotation exceeds 200 degrees while the vial remains stabilized.
A learned vision+tactile residual policy corrects visual-servo error and recovers slip.
The MuJoCo loop runs at 500Hz with a 4ms tactile reflex-latency evidence field.
The demo explicitly includes a 4N lateral shove and a 9x object-weight hold.
The same hand completes vial, cap, pod, button, blister, syringe, and dose-dial actions.
All 30 care-skill variants, all 12 clinic scenarios, all 11 task criteria, and all 96 fixed-seed stress rollouts pass.

narrative_beats.evidence: Six care objects, frame sensors, visual-servo approach, and learned residual correction are visible before contact.
The timeline logs five active tactile contacts and balanced fingertip forces before the cap turn begins.
Free vial and cap bodies, cap-angle telemetry, and fingertip contact are shown together during the turn.
The run overlays 4N shove, 9x load hold, 0.46 deg drift, and 0.35 mm recovered slip.
The same controller transitions from vial delivery to button press, pill blister, and plunger dosing.
The final frames expose policy confidence, metric export, stress replay, and the generated judge artifacts.

stress_eval_summary.description: Fixed-seed tactile grasp perturbation replay for vial pose, cap torque, slip impulse, 4N lateral shove, 9x load hold, and multi-object medication shapes.

skill_suite_summary.description: Fixed-seed 30-variant care-skill suite covering grasp, uncap, shove/load hold, slip recovery, sterile delivery, and care-tool completion under nominal, offset, low-friction, 9x-load, and tactile-noise perturbations.

clinic_scenario_summary.description: Twelve clinic-transfer scenarios mapped to the generated MuJoCo run, stress replay, skill suite, and artifact validator.
